usage: fleet-switchboard verdict [-h] --pr PR [--plan PLAN] [--ask ASK]
                                 [--head HEAD] [--all]
                                 --as {ci,tester,reviewer,owner}
                                 --result {pass,fail} --evidence EVIDENCE
                                 [scenario]

positional arguments:
  scenario              The scenario id in the plan (S1, U2, ...)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --pr PR               The pull request: owner/repo#N or its URL
  --plan PLAN           The plan: owner/repo#N or an issue URL (default: the
                        one the PR's ledger entries name, else the `PLAN:`
                        line of the PR body)
  --ask ASK             The ask whose Done-when the plan must cover (as `plan
                        check --ask`)
  --head HEAD           The PR head sha (default: read from GitHub)
  --all                 Record the verdict for EVERY per-PR scenario of the
                        plan judged by --as, at the current head (no scenario
                        id)
  --as {ci,tester,reviewer,owner}
  --result {pass,fail}
  --evidence EVIDENCE   A link, or the evaluator's own artefact

usage: fleet-switchboard waive [-h] --gates GATES --reason REASON
                               [--head HEAD]
                               pr

Waive gates G0 to G5 for ONE PR at its CURRENT head, for a hotfix: the chief
of staff (or a person at a shell) only, with a reason of at least 20
characters, never G6, G7 or G8 and never by a writer of the PR. A ledger entry
and an audit line; it lasts 24 hours (the retroactive plan is due then) and a
push needs a new one. `gates` shows the gate as waived, not passed.

positional arguments:
  pr               The pull request: owner/repo#N or its URL

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --gates GATES    Comma-separated gates: G0a,G0b,G0c,G1,G2/G3,G4,G5, or MG
                   (the merge gate, #962)
  --reason REASON  Why (at least 20 characters)
  --head HEAD      The PR head sha (default: read from GitHub)

usage: fleet-switchboard triage [-h] {seen-leave,unmute,muted} ...

`triage seen-leave OWNER/REPO#N` keeps the item out of the Chief of Staff's
stale digest until it changes (a comment, a label, a state or a push). `triage
unmute OWNER/REPO#N` undoes it; `triage muted` lists them.

positional arguments:
  {seen-leave,unmute,muted}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
